page.overview:
Who is D.D.?

D.D., real name , also known by the nickname , his emblem The Goddess of Thunder / Fierce God and his code Ogre, is a character who was originally supposed to appear in the canceled Capcom Fighting All-Stars as one of the four original characters, collectively known as the Code Holders. Due to his connection to Ingrid from her appearance in Street Fighter Alpha 3 MAX, he was given a profile in the Street Fighter V character guide while he makes his first official appearance as a cameo in Street Fighter 6 as part of Ingrid's World Tour Mode.

D.D. is a mysterious man whose peculiar genes were awakened by a mysterious organization, thus becoming a "CODE HOLDER". He stands together with his friends Rook and Ingrid, to stop a big disaster that will happen in Metro City. He is able to destroy anything with the crimson thunder on his fists.

D.D. is a power fighter focusing mainly on hard hits. His Specials could be linked, thus making a Special-to-Special combo. He possesses a powerful rush ability, but on the other hand is weak to Dramatic Counters. He also specialized in linear tactics.

D.D. appeared in the rhythm RPG Otoranger alongside Ingrid and Rook as a team character named Code Holder.
